name: Stage 62: Kvarnsjön to Svarvaretorp, etapp 7
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 62, Kvarnsjön to Svarvaretorp, etapp 7.
utilities: Kvarnsjön start has no formal trail parking or direct all-hours service. Practical access is via Grödinge kyrka/SL 727 and the blue connector; check SL because bus service can be sparse and the direct 70 km/h road option has no sidewalk.

Rosenhill cafe/kiosk and bus access sit about 1 km south of the trail after the Nynäshamnsvägen crossing, but the road approach is narrow and traffic-heavy. Treat Rosenhill as a deliberate detour, not a core trail facility.

The core stage service points are sparse: unreliable Axsjön/Axaren spring, Getaren shelter/fireplace, bird-bay boardwalk/hide, and Svarvaretorp access/parking. Toilets, tap water, restaurant, bus, larger parking, tenting, and managed outdoor-center services are at Lida after continuing on Stage 7.
waterSources: Axsjön/Axaren spring north of Axsjön is the official natural water source, but June/July 2025 hiker reports said it was almost dry, dry, or overgrown. Treat/filter/boil and carry enough water to finish without it.
Getaren lake water is emergency natural water only; no potable tap was verified at the shelter. Treat/filter and avoid relying on lake water during algal bloom or poor-water periods.
Lida friluftsgård has reliable service water/tap context after the stage via the Stage 7 continuation, including water by Lida Gym/Naturport/tent-meadow areas; Rosenhill may sell drinks when open.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Stage 62 is Kvarnsjön to Svarvaretorp, 7.7 km. Current OSM/Naturkartan geometry measures about 7.43-7.44 km, OSM metadata under-rounds to 7 km, AllTrails is close at 7.6 km, and noisy TopoGPS tracks can reach 8 km or more. Use the official catalog distance and corrected east/northeast geometry toward Getaren/Svarvaretorp.

The stage runs Kvarnsjön, Husby/Husby Hammare, Nynäshamnsvägen/Rosenhill detour area, horse-pasture bypass, Axsjön spring, Nolinge, the Norrgaviken/Getaren route choice, Getaren shelter, bird-bay boardwalk/hide, and Svarvaretorp/Stage 7 junction.

At the Norrgaviken/Getaren split, the official text and local reports recommend the south/right lakeside option for shelter, views, Jungfruberget/Norrgaviken scenery, and more varied terrain; the north/left option is shorter/direct and should be modeled as an alternate variant if available.

The official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass, but 2025 hiker comments/reviews described overgrown or hard-to-see tread, muddy stretches, clear-cut/bare areas, and the Axsjön source as almost dry or dry/overgrown.

Road safety matters around the Grödinge church access road and Nynäshamnsvägen/Rosenhill detour. Avoid the 70 km/h no-sidewalk road option where the gravel-road/blue connector is available, and use care near crossings.
A horse pasture after the road crossing has a signed bypass. Follow the bypass when needed and keep dogs controlled; national dog supervision rules are stricter from 1 March to 20 August.

Norrga/Lida reserve and outdoor-area rules apply near Getaren/Lida. Do not damage rock/soil, remove living or dead wood, harm plants/mosses/lichens/fungi, or take wood-decay fungi; avoid dead-spruce areas in wind and keep fires to prepared places when fires are allowed.
Getaren has eutrophication pressure and Norrgaån is ecologically sensitive. Avoid washing, soap, dishwater, or waste in the lake/streams.

Getaren shelter is free, shared, first-come, and has no guaranteed firewood or trash service. Shelter-map data lists about six sleeping places, but availability is first-come. Lida's managed tent meadow/bookable lodging is the cleaner overnight plan when open/allowed.

Around Lida many tracks intersect, some local trails have ongoing access limits, and Äventyrsstigen is closed until further notice because it crosses private business/agricultural land. Follow S-marked/Sörmlandsleden arrows carefully and check the last SL bus before committing to an evening finish.

Do not naively import Sörmlandsleden's bundled full-network GPX as a single Stage 62 route: it splits the Stage 62 branch choice and Stage 7/Lida continuation into separate unnamed segments that can create false gaps, duplicated variants, or a wrong endpoint.

facilities.name: Kvarnsjön stage 62 start
facilities.description: Official Stage 62 start and Stage 61/62 junction. No formal service is verified at the exact junction.

facilities.name: No formal Kvarnsjön trail parking
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden notes no parking at the start, though a roadside pocket may be possible nearby. Do not treat this as a formal trailhead lot.

facilities.name: Grödinge kyrka bus 727 access
facilities.description: SL 727 access via Grödinge kyrka and the blue connector toward Kvarnsjön. Check live departures before relying on it.

facilities.name: Grödinge road-walk caution
facilities.description: Road access from Grödinge can involve a narrow 70 km/h road without sidewalk. Prefer the blue-marked connector where possible.

facilities.name: Husby / Husby Hammare cultural area
facilities.description: Cultural-landscape/rest context near the route before the road crossing. Approximate pin; not a guaranteed service point.

facilities.name: Nynäshamnsvägen crossing caution
facilities.description: Use care at and near the larger road crossing. The Rosenhill detour uses narrow, traffic-heavy road margins.

facilities.name: Rosenhill cafe/kiosk detour
facilities.description: Opening-hour-dependent food and drink about 1 km south of the trail. Useful but not on the direct stage line.

facilities.name: Rosenhill bus access
facilities.description: Bus access near Rosenhill, reached by detour from the route. Check SL because service varies.

facilities.name: Horse pasture bypass
facilities.description: Signed bypass around a horse pasture after the road crossing toward Axån. Use the bypass if horses/livestock are present or you are uncomfortable; keep dogs short-leashed.

facilities.name: Axsjön / Axaren spring
facilities.description: Official natural source north of Axsjön. Treat/filter/boil; not a tested potable tap. June/July 2025 hiker reports said it was almost dry, dry, or overgrown, so carry enough water to finish without it.

facilities.name: Axsjön spring dry caveat
facilities.description: Recent 2025 hiker reports said the spring was almost dry, dry, or overgrown. Treat it as a bonus source only, not a plan-critical refill.

facilities.name: Norrga dead-spruce caution
facilities.description: Norrga reserve has bark-beetle dead-spruce warnings; standing dead spruce can fall suddenly and without warning. Avoid this section in wind and follow local closure signs.

facilities.name: Norrga reserve rules
facilities.description: Norrga reserve: do not damage rock/soil, living or dead trees, plants, mosses, lichens, fungi, insects, or wildlife, and do not remove dead wood. Keep to marked paths and pack out waste.

facilities.name: Norrgaviken / Getaren route choice
facilities.description: Route-choice fork after Nolinge: north/left is shorter/direct; south/right is the recommended scenic line via Norrgaviken, Jungfruberget, Getaren shelter, views, bird boardwalk, and more varied nature. Current OSM/Naturkartan primary geometry follows the southern option.

facilities.name: Stage 62 GPX fragment caveat
facilities.description: The official bundled full-network GPX splits Stage 62's branch choice and Stage 7 continuation into separate unnamed segments. Do not import it as one ordered Stage 62 route; use OSM/Naturkartan geometry plus explicit variants.

facilities.name: Getaren shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter/rest point by Getaren. Free, shared, first-come; shelter-map data lists about six sleeping places, with no guaranteed firewood or trash service.

facilities.name: Getaren fireplace
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace beside the Getaren shelter. Use only when fires are allowed, bring fuel if needed, avoid disposable grills, and do not remove wood in reserve/outdoor-area land.

facilities.name: Getaren natural water only
facilities.description: Lake water only at the shelter area; no potable tap was verified and shelter listings mark water quality unknown. Treat/filter and carry backup. Avoid soap, dishwater, toileting, or washing in Getaren/Norrgaån.

facilities.name: Getaren/Jungfruberget viewpoint area
facilities.description: Lake/viewpoint rest context near Getaren and Jungfruberget. Approximate marker, not a service guarantee.

facilities.name: Getaren bird-bay boardwalk/hide
facilities.description: Boardwalk/bird-hide area near the north end of Getaren. Expect wet footing and stay on constructed paths where signed.

facilities.name: Stage 62 endpoint caveat
facilities.description: Official text treats Svarvaretorp/Stage 7 as the Stage 62 goal and Lida as a 1 km continuation. OSM relation 5655292 continues toward Lida, so show Lida as continuation/access rather than core Stage 62.

facilities.name: Svarvaretorp Stage 62 / Stage 7 junction
facilities.description: Best current OSM/Naturkartan Stage 62 endpoint and connection to Stage 7 toward Lida. The official endpoint coordinate is not published; do not substitute Lida's service coordinate as the stage endpoint.

facilities.name: Svarvaretorp parking/access
facilities.description: Parking/access near the Stage 62 finish/Lida side; Sörmlandsleden says parking is about 100 m left of the stage end. Confirm local signs and avoid assuming overnight parking permission.

facilities.name: Stage 7 continuation toward Lida
facilities.description: Onward trail connection after Stage 62 toward Lida and Stage 7. Use this for Lida services, but do not count Lida as part of Stage 62 proper.

facilities.name: Lida friluftsgård services
facilities.description: Restaurant/cafe, outdoor-center services, bathing area, and managed facilities after the stage via Stage 7. Verify opening hours before relying on food or indoor toilets.

facilities.name: Lida/Getaren bathing quality
facilities.description: Lidabadet/Getaren had 2026 bathing-season classification Utmärkt kvalitet from 2025 samples, but check live samples and algal-bloom status during warm periods.

facilities.name: Lida service water
facilities.description: Reliable service-water context at Lida friluftsgård when facilities are open/available, including taps near Lida Gym/Vandrarhemmet and tent-area service buildings. After-stage refill, not on Stage 62 proper.

facilities.name: Lida toilets
facilities.description: Toilets at Lida friluftsgård area, opening/access dependent; Lida lists several seasonal/time-limited toilet clusters. After-stage facility via Stage 7.

facilities.name: Lida bus 721
facilities.description: Bus access at Lida after continuing beyond Stage 62. Last departures can be early; check SL live before using as a finish plan.

facilities.name: Lida parking
facilities.description: Large Lida outdoor-center parking after the stage via Stage 7. Lida says parking is only in signed areas and not at the bus stop or inside the area; follow current signs and overnight rules.

facilities.name: Lida tent meadow
facilities.description: Managed tenting option at/near Lida when permitted/booked, with hygiene hut/toilet/tap context. Use Lida's current rules rather than assuming allemansrätten camping in developed outdoor-center areas; longer reserve camping can require permission.

facilities.name: Lida local trail limitations
facilities.description: Some local Lida trails have ongoing access limitations, and Äventyrsstigen is closed until further notice because it crosses private business/agricultural land. Do not use it as a reroute.

facilities.name: Lida grill shelter rules
facilities.description: Lida grill/fireplace context after the stage. Use prepared places, bring permitted fuel when required, obey current fire bans, and avoid disposable grills where prohibited.
